title: The coach sees a client's first two weeks on the day the client's phone last saved, not on today
why: Coach Milan 20 November 14:30, with a screenshot of Clients: today is Friday, but the week of three clients in their first two weeks is not correct.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan's own look at Clients, 20 November 2026, 14:30, on the live app.
opportunity.job: As the coach on check-in day, see at a glance how far each client is and which days need a word.
opportunity.why_now: Three clients are in their first two weeks and have check-ins today.

problem: On Clients, a client on day 8 of 14 shows the outline for today on day 5, a Tuesday. The two days after it look still to come. Her page says day 5 of 14. Cause: the squares are the picture the client's phone sent when it last saved. A client who has not opened the app since Tuesday leaves Tuesday's picture. The line above, day 8 of 14, is counted on the coach's today, so the card says two different things.
story: When I open Clients on check-in day, I want each client's days drawn on today, so that I see where they are and which days nothing came in.

ac.title: Today is today
ac.text: Given a client on day 8 of 14 whose phone last saved on day 5, when I open Clients, then the outline is on day 8, today.

ac.title: The days since are amber
ac.text: Given the same client, when I look at days 6 and 7, then they are amber, not fully logged, because nothing came from the phone for them.

ac.title: The days ahead stay grey
ac.text: Given the same client, when I look at days 9 to 14, then they are grey, still to come.

ac.title: Her page says the same
ac.text: Given I open that client, when I see her measured burn, then it says day 8 of 14, with the same squares as her card.

ac.title: The count follows
ac.text: Given the squares are counted again, when I read the line under them, then the full days are the green squares.

unchanged: The client's own Today and Goal: her phone already counts on her today.
The days a phone sent: a full day stays green, a day not fully logged stays amber.
The measured burn, its numbers and Ready on: they come from her phone as before.
A client in a normal week: one row, Monday to Sunday.
short: Clients: the first two weeks are drawn on today
rel: Drawn; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: B153: the coach sees a client's first two weeks on today, not on the day her phone last saved
now: The squares on the card and on the client's page are the phone's picture from the day it last saved.
proposed: The coach's phone draws the squares again on its own today, from the days that came with the picture: today has the outline, the days since are amber, the days ahead are grey. The full days are counted again from them.
decision: Open. Drawn for Coach Milan's Go.
details: The pictures are the coach demo on Friday 20 November, 14:26, from one scratch build of 0.3.169, not committed. Lena is made up: day 8 of 14, her phone last saved on day 5.
The same three clients on the live app show it the same way: the outline on the day their phones last saved.
Only the coach's views change: the Clients card and the client's page.
